text: Lal Narayan Sinha was a lawyer who served as the Attorney General of India from 9 August 1979 to 8 August 1983 and as the Solicitor General of India from 17 July 1972 to 5 April 1977. He was educated at Patna Law College, Patna University. He was the first Attorney General to represent a private party during their term in office. Before assuming the role of Solicitor General of India, he served as the Advocate General of Bihar for several years. His son, Lalit Mohan Sharma, became the Chief Justice of India, and his grandson, Justice Partha Sarthy, currently serves as a Judge in the Patna High Court.
